mechanism: Rasagiline is a selective MAO-B inhibitor that at higher doses can inhibit MAO-A, potentially causing serotonin syndrome when combined with serotonergic agents; captopril itself has minimal serotonergic activity but the combination increases sympathomimetic sensitivity and hypotension risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and counsel patient on avoidance of sympathomimetic amines and tyramine-rich foods; the combination is generally acceptable but requires vigilance for hypotensive episodes.
